title: View switch
description: List ↔ grid and an optional density toggle, as small icon toggles at the end of the filter row (FilterChipRow trailing).
when: A collection people browse both as rows and as cards (products, files, suppliers).
A dense list where some people want more rows on screen (density).

instead.need: Switching between different data or status slices
A table ↔ chart switch of one data set

a11y: A group named “Kiểu xem” of toggle buttons (aria-pressed), each with an aria-label and a title.
The density button is pressed while the view is compact.
notes: Keep the view in the URL (?view=grid, replace, not push) when people share it, or per person (localStorage) when it is a taste.
On phones it moves into FilterPanel's children or the settings button of PhoneFilterBar.
